acceptanceTasks: Reopen the owning routine after actual process termination; restore authored name, notes, staged targets, raw numeric text/unit context and paste text without submitting.
Create from a selected canonical Library lift, preserve its ID across reopening, and save exactly one routine without repeating a search.

Inspect lost acknowledgement, unavailable read, changed owner and partially accepted batch. Retry only proven outstanding stable records, without recreating or overwriting conflicts.
Keep Back's successful flush/write-through contract. Retain unfinished fields when leaving after failure; explicit private discard cannot undo already saved lifts/order/targets.

Read and validate import before any business write; preview matched/unmatched/duplicate lines, ordered routines, note-only sessions and actual weekly-pin effects. Cancel/reopen retains text and does not create a program.
Confirm the exact frozen import once; reconcile interrupted/partial outcomes and show accurate receipt. Preserve established authored notes, hold prescriptions, alternatives and weekly-layout rules.
Remove only the empty newly created stub, preserve existing empty/imported routines and saved history, and keep cleanup failure truthful.
